answer_2.quote: The benchmark employs two metrics for evaluation: (1) Pass Rate measures the percentage of instructions successfully executed within the allocated budget. (2) Win Rate represents the preference selection by a ChatGPT evaluator...

answer_3.quote: Win Rate is calculated by comparing each model with ChatGPT-ReACT. A win rate higher than 50% means the model performs better than ChatGPT-ReACT.
